Specification: This module specifies a very small integer-valued transition system used to test action invariants. It has a single variable x, starts in state x = 0, and on each next-state step increments x by either 1 or 2. The file defines both state invariants and action invariants, including true and false examples, but it does not define a temporal specification such as Spec or any fairness conditions.
